thread:
mike: incident-bot: ALERT: spike in fallback routing activity affecting ap-south-1 -> increased p95 and 5xx. auto-pager triggered.
oncall-bot: Pager opened: severity=P1, assignee=@anya, runbook=/runbooks/fallback-retry-amplification.md
anya: taking this. loading traces and route tables. what's the initial failover path?
mike: looks like primary us-east pool degraded, smart-routing tried regional fallback -> ap-south-1, then some requests re-failed and retried back to us-east which then re-failed, causing repeated hops.
sre_lead: that sounds like failover loop + client retries. confirm whether `max_failover_hops` is configured.
anya: config shows `max_failover_hops=2` (default). combined with clients doing sync retries, that allowed multi-hop amplification.
ops_pager: are certain model variants getting overloaded?
mike: yes — `v4-quant` (fallback eligible) is getting hammered. also the fallback preference includes a recently onboarded quantized variant with unknown concurrency profile.
cs_tom: two customers reported timeouts. I've messaged them "we're investigating; mitigation in progress".
anya: mitigation plan: 1) set `max_failover_hops=1` to prevent bounce, 2) temporarily blacklist v4-quant from fallback, 3) add short-lived per-source rate-limits at edge, 4) enable immediate 429 short-circuit for repeated failover attempts, 5) coordinate SDK action to add jitter/backoff guidance.
mike: executing (1): `PATCH /config/global` payload: {"max_failover_hops":"1"}
anya: applied. verifying: show config -> `max_failover_hops=1` now.
mike: blacklisting variant: `PATCH /config/routing/fallback` body: {"exclude": ["v4-quant"]}
ops_pager: rule applied. traffic shifting to `v2-stable`.
anya: pushing edge rate-limit: nginx-gateway - set `limit_req zone=fallback burst=250 nodelay` for 20m
mike: added short-circuit: if request.failure_count > 3 within 30s return `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests` with header `Retry-After: 15`
sdk_kim: SDK note: we'll push a 1.12.1 patch to set default `max_retries=2` and introduce jitter; filing SDK-129.
cs_tom: telling customers: "We've applied mitigations (routing & rate limits). We recommend clients adopt jittered retries. We'll follow up with postmortem"
anya: monitoring: 5xx dropped from 9% -> 1.8% in 4 mins, p95 latency back to baseline. affected traffic ~9% of ap-south region for ~22 minutes; two paying accounts impacted.
sre_lead: follow-ups: revert the onboarding of v4-quant to fallback until perf characterization completed, add CI test for fallback eligibility based on perf tags, implement server-side circuit-breaker per-src pool, and change default `max_failover_hops` to 1.
mike: creating INF-4120 with action items. handing over to @mike for postmortem writeup. anya: please own customer comms until postmortem is posted.
anya: will do. reactions: :heavy_check_mark: from @sre_lead.
oncall-bot: Pager closed: severity downgraded to P3 at 2012350365 — mitigations holding. followup ticket INF-4120 created
